name: A Token of Good Faith
label: Quest
description: A Token of Good Faith: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.
Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Why are you addressing me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.
There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
